programme.title: 明猩學園 #2
programme.desc: 跟隨剛畢業的貝尼,與同學蘇拉,梅里爾和威恩,一起展開明猩學園導賞團拜訪剛報到的新生莫莉,並與納丁博士一起上課,看她如何為慢吞吞的布米和野孩子莫妮塔評分

programme.title: 非洲獵人 #5 英普
programme.desc: 野狗群的世界正在面對一場巨變,他們豐富的狩獵地正受到斑點鬣狗群的威脅脆弱的狗寶寶已開始挨餓,因為無情的獵食者對手偷走了他們的食物,最終還突擊他們的棲身地

programme.title: 非洲獵人 #6 英普
programme.desc: 對獅子來說,水牛固然是令人滿足的晚餐,但同時也是危險的獵物與穆瓦姆巴獅群一起追蹤為數近三百頭水牛,並從中窺探他們的獵食技巧,他們必須迅速而謹慎地行動

programme.title: 美洲豹日誌 #1
programme.desc: 跟隨麗茲·戴利及其團隊前往潘塔納爾,追尋一隻失蹤的雄性美洲豹領袖,並親眼目睹年輕挑戰者之間的戰鬥見證局外人巴達洛如何篡奪權力,並贏得菲拉和其他雌性美洲豹的歡心

programme.title: 獅群的法則 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​來認識「濱水」獅群的成員吧:雄獅湯姆・湯姆與卡勒,八隻雌獅,十頭年輕的獅子,以及愛因斯坦,那頭從未離開家園,如今已長成的幼獅當愛因斯坦的反叛之舉逐漸發酵,最終在「外來者」獅群的對手發動攻勢時,為他釘下了命運的定局

programme.title: 獅群的法則 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​感受炙熱高溫,當獅群努力狩獵足夠食物,乾旱條件逼迫他們與獵物一同陷入接近死亡的險境,生命幾乎被推向邊緣觀看愛因斯坦適應孤獨生活,然後評估戰場殘局,在新手母親卡爾維茲為幼崽性命而奮戰之後

programme.title: 獅群的法則 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​面對雨季的挑戰,這個季節讓一切轉為綠意盎然,同時破壞了獅子隱蔽的保護色,掩飾效果徹底失靈觀看愛因斯坦無法建立新的聯繫,並權衡得失,在琪薩與牠的幼崽被敵對雄獅瘋眼穆迪綁走之時

programme.title: 獅群的法則 #4
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​迎來豐饒季節的問候,當洪水退去,大群獵物再度回到喬貝河岸邊,重現成群聚集的壯觀場景觀看琪薩帶著幼崽嘗試逃離,卡勒與湯湯則與對手搏鬥激戰,然後歡呼愛因斯坦終於找到配偶

programme.title: 獅群的法則 #5
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​走向循環的終點,隨著乾季降臨,濱水獅群重新享受良好的狩獵成果,並在自己的領土裡恢復信心最後慶祝前外來者愛因斯坦的成功,他現在已經開始真正行使王者的責任,成為屬於他自己的獅群之王

programme.title: 驕傲之地:野地回春
programme.desc: 一個澳洲家庭在南非的一個古老狩獵牧場進行修復他們的目標是重建過度生長的棲息地,建立生態旅游牧場,並允許包括獵食者在內的自然野生動植物搬回家

programme.title: 美洲豹日誌 #1
programme.desc: 跟隨麗茲·戴利及其團隊前往潘塔納爾,追尋一隻失蹤的雄性美洲豹領袖,並親眼目睹年輕挑戰者之間的戰鬥見證局外人巴達洛如何篡奪權力,並贏得菲拉和其他雌性美洲豹的歡心

programme.title: 獅群的法則 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​來認識「濱水」獅群的成員吧:雄獅湯姆・湯姆與卡勒,八隻雌獅,十頭年輕的獅子,以及愛因斯坦,那頭從未離開家園,如今已長成的幼獅當愛因斯坦的反叛之舉逐漸發酵,最終在「外來者」獅群的對手發動攻勢時,為他釘下了命運的定局

programme.title: 獅群的法則 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​感受炙熱高溫,當獅群努力狩獵足夠食物,乾旱條件逼迫他們與獵物一同陷入接近死亡的險境,生命幾乎被推向邊緣觀看愛因斯坦適應孤獨生活,然後評估戰場殘局,在新手母親卡爾維茲為幼崽性命而奮戰之後

programme.title: 獅群的法則 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​面對雨季的挑戰,這個季節讓一切轉為綠意盎然,同時破壞了獅子隱蔽的保護色,掩飾效果徹底失靈觀看愛因斯坦無法建立新的聯繫,並權衡得失,在琪薩與牠的幼崽被敵對雄獅瘋眼穆迪綁走之時

programme.title: 獅群的法則 #4
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​迎來豐饒季節的問候,當洪水退去,大群獵物再度回到喬貝河岸邊,重現成群聚集的壯觀場景觀看琪薩帶著幼崽嘗試逃離,卡勒與湯湯則與對手搏鬥激戰,然後歡呼愛因斯坦終於找到配偶

programme.title: 獅群的法則 #5
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​走向循環的終點,隨著乾季降臨,濱水獅群重新享受良好的狩獵成果,並在自己的領土裡恢復信心最後慶祝前外來者愛因斯坦的成功,他現在已經開始真正行使王者的責任,成為屬於他自己的獅群之王

programme.title: 獅群的法則 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​來認識「濱水」獅群的成員吧:雄獅湯姆・湯姆與卡勒,八隻雌獅,十頭年輕的獅子,以及愛因斯坦,那頭從未離開家園,如今已長成的幼獅當愛因斯坦的反叛之舉逐漸發酵,最終在「外來者」獅群的對手發動攻勢時,為他釘下了命運的定局

programme.title: 獅群的法則 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​感受炙熱高溫,當獅群努力狩獵足夠食物,乾旱條件逼迫他們與獵物一同陷入接近死亡的險境,生命幾乎被推向邊緣觀看愛因斯坦適應孤獨生活,然後評估戰場殘局,在新手母親卡爾維茲為幼崽性命而奮戰之後

programme.title: 獅群的法則 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​面對雨季的挑戰,這個季節讓一切轉為綠意盎然,同時破壞了獅子隱蔽的保護色,掩飾效果徹底失靈觀看愛因斯坦無法建立新的聯繫,並權衡得失,在琪薩與牠的幼崽被敵對雄獅瘋眼穆迪綁走之時

programme.title: 獅群的法則 #4
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​迎來豐饒季節的問候,當洪水退去,大群獵物再度回到喬貝河岸邊,重現成群聚集的壯觀場景觀看琪薩帶著幼崽嘗試逃離,卡勒與湯湯則與對手搏鬥激戰,然後歡呼愛因斯坦終於找到配偶

programme.title: 獅群的法則 #5
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​走向循環的終點,隨著乾季降臨,濱水獅群重新享受良好的狩獵成果,並在自己的領土裡恢復信心最後慶祝前外來者愛因斯坦的成功,他現在已經開始真正行使王者的責任,成為屬於他自己的獅群之王

programme.title: 大貓國度 #1
programme.desc: 在盧安瓜谷,強大的孟巴肯高獅群仍有17頭壯獅,但老化的雄性領導無以為繼在北方,荷里活獅群中的六隻雌獅已經自給自足了三年,但沒有雄性與她們交配,可能導致族群滅絕四名年輕流浪雄獅突然的造訪,似乎回應著荷里活獅群的祈禱

programme.title: 大貓國度 #2
programme.desc: 在盧安瓜谷,荷里活獅群大難臨頭流浪雄獅的侵襲使女族長阿華受了重傷由於首領喪失能力,狩獵變得困難在尋找獅子的過程中,阿森發現了一隻鬣狗幼崽,牠的母親去打獵時遺下牠鬣狗與孟巴肯高獅群因爭奪一隻水牛的屍體而大打出手彌敦收到驚喜:孟巴肯高獅群原來藏著更多的幼獅

programme.title: 大貓國度 #3
programme.desc: 四頭流浪雄獅組成的暴力團,正尋找可接管的獅群他們在盧安瓜河的西岸徘徊,並已跟北方的荷里活雌獅群大打一場,現正南下進入強大的孟巴肯高獅群的地盤孟巴肯高的雌獅群的狩獵隊阻止他們接近,但她們的策略只能持續幾天

programme.title: 大貓國度 #4
programme.desc: 流浪雄獅最近的入侵將孟巴肯高獅群分散到了遙遠的南方,留下那些失去了首領- 叛逆者的保護,易遭攻擊的幼獅現在旱季已經過了一半,炎熱的天氣降低了河水的水位,金巴和瑪雅兄妹倆冒險過河尋找父母

programme.title: 大貓國度 #5
programme.desc: 在盧安瓜谷的荷里活獅群正身處水深火熱向北避難以逃離流浪雄獅,其他獅子來到威脅霸佔牠們的領土當牠們嘗試回歸時,流浪雄獅又趕到阻止牠們前進

programme.title: 大貓國度 #6
programme.desc: 旱季即將結束,孟巴肯高獅群面臨前所未有的艱難時刻牠們的女族長和最強獵人蘇拉比被一頭水牛所傷,讓她命懸一線同時,彌敦找到了獅群中最年輕的成員之一,孤身走失的小獅斑點

programme.desc: Ben 來到坎特伯裡的高峰牧場,了解這座高地農場從產地到餐桌的體驗,以及家族世代守護土地的故事接著,他前往多拉荒野海岸,拜訪一對以永續方式採集海鮮的夫婦--他們以推土機將漁船推進大海,展開一天的捕撈旅程

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #3
programme.desc: Ben 來到黑斯廷斯,發現當地以整合式的全方位方法生產草飼安格斯牛肉他造訪在地農夫市集,認識了許多優秀的本地食品生產者,展現出這個地區豐饒的農產品

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #4
programme.desc: Ben 拜訪了一位果園經營者與食品創新專家他們共同的願景是製作天然,以品種為主導的蘋果汁,並採用世界最先進的技術他也參觀了位於霍克斯灣地中海型氣候下所培育的超過三十種無花果

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #5
programme.desc: Ben 搭船前往阿卡羅瓦的一座鮭魚養殖場,了解紐西蘭帝王鮭與大西洋鮭的不同之處他親自捕撈鮭魚,並在俯瞰港灣的海岸邊烹調他也介紹了一款高品質的本地食用油,兼具健康與多功能性,體現對本地農業與永續的承諾

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #6
programme.desc: 正值核果盛產季節!Ben 造訪中奧塔哥一個由家族經營的果園,該果園以核果產季長,與土地及社區的緊密連結而聞名他發現了一座全電力運作的櫻桃農場,將優質外銷櫻桃直接販售給紐西蘭民眾

programme.title: 女神們 #4
programme.desc: 蒂娜透娜是我們這個時代最偉大的表演者之一,她那具爆發力的嗓音,令人興奮的舞臺表演和啟發性的人生故事俘虜全球數百萬人的心靈

programme.title: 女神們 #5
programme.desc: 芭芭拉史翠珊以其高亢,精緻的嗓音本事和魅力四射的個性,使她成為一生中最具創意和商業上最成功的表演者之一

programme.title: 阿諾史瓦辛格:為行動而生
programme.desc: 從塔爾(Thal)的平凡起點,到成為好萊塢最響亮的名字之一他以健美運動員出身,隨後轉戰演藝界與政壇,這就是傳奇動作巨星阿諾·史瓦辛格(Arnold Schwarzenegger)的一生與諸多考驗

programme.title: 傳奇拳王: 曼尼帕奎奧
programme.desc: 這是拳擊界最勢不可擋的力量之一的非凡旅程曼尼柏基奧的傳奇將因其在拳擊場內外所實現的變革而被永遠銘記

programme.title: 湯姆克魯斯:開麥啦
programme.desc: 剛登六的湯姆克魯斯仍然是好萊塢頂流之一作為一位多產的演員,他的職業生涯橫跨40年,不斷在電影界創造巨大的遺產

programme.title: 布萊德彼特:突破好萊塢
programme.desc: 他可能是最性感的好萊塢演員之一,但他的職業和個人目標比他的外表更有味道布萊德彼特整個好萊塢首屈一指的人物之一一個默默無聞的天才轉變為超級巨星的故事

programme.title: 追夢女賽車手 #1
programme.desc: 業餘賽車手蕭詠詩 (Vivian Siu) 夢想徵戰澳門格蘭披治大賽她自費且經驗極少,迅速躍升至 F4,成為中國錦標賽首位女車手她面臨著技術和籌集關鍵資金的巨大挑戰

programme.title: 追夢女賽車手 #2
programme.desc: 澳門大賽從賽程中移除,Vivian 的賽車之旅遭遇挫折,夢想面臨終結即使有一絲希望,她仍需在數週內完成尋找賽車,車隊和搭檔車手的艱鉅任務

programme.title: ABBA樂團:歐洲歌唱大賽後的半世紀
programme.desc: 從頭記錄ABBA由歐洲歌唱大賽到崛起成全球巨星,他們標誌性的嗓音,破紀錄的成功,單飛的努力,ABBA精選唱片- Gold的復甦,以及先進的全息投影巡演- 《啟航》,樂隊以虛擬形式重聚

programme.title: 阿諾史瓦辛格:為行動而生
programme.desc: 從塔爾(Thal)的平凡起點,到成為好萊塢最響亮的名字之一他以健美運動員出身,隨後轉戰演藝界與政壇,這就是傳奇動作巨星阿諾·史瓦辛格(Arnold Schwarzenegger)的一生與諸多考驗

programme.title: 夏奇拉:新時代女性
programme.desc: 講述唱片銷量超過1億哥倫比亞出生的超級巨星莎琦拉的故事;還有她堅定不移的倡議和慈善努力,使她成為有類似志向的藝人和粉絲的榜樣

programme.title: 惠妮休斯頓: 天籟背後
programme.desc: 一段震撼人心的旅程,深入描繪惠妮休斯頓如流星般崛起的人生--從福音音樂的根源到全球巨星的巔峰,揭開錯綜複雜的情感關係,與成癮搏鬥的陰影,以及那把曾無可動搖,最終令人心碎的嗓音,在她英年早逝前的起落沉浮

Pocket sized pets are currently all the rage, but there are details you need to pay attention to when raising them For example, hedgehogs are highly defensive, timid sugar gliders will harm themselves without being next to their owners, and cute guinea pigs like Norman from the movie "The Secret Life of Pets" are easily abandoned due to being easy to obtain and raise, etc Don't worry, experts will teach you how to raise them! programme.desc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

programme.desc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South AmericaThey have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes

programme.desc: A startling scientific discovery has changed the face of evolutionary science A single tooth shook the scientific community The secrets the skulls of ancient ape-men, found in a Beijing suburb potentially held the key to the missing link in Human evolution Dozens of experts formed an international team in an attempt to uncover the tracks of this specimen, and find out more about its habits On the eve of war, these skulls suddenly disappeared off the face of the earth, leaving no trace As the history unfolds, scientists debated the origin of the Peking ape-man, as the world wonders where his remains might be

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: Discover China is a documentary series shot in conjunction with the Chinese Ministry of Culture and China Central Television, including footage of never before seen locations and recreations of historical events It was shot by BBC film crews over a four year period At the foot of Tai Mountain sits an enigma, a temple that bears a striking resemblance to an Imperial palace It was built by a brazen emperor, who ignored his country's desparation, and built this lavish shrine to bolster his status as the sole ruler

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Silent, covert, deadly; they are every battle commander’s secret weapon Snipers are the long-range killers on the battlefield We travel to several renowned sniper schools to see them train; learn about their advanced technology weapons and unique field craft

programme.title: Banzai Switzerland
programme.desc: Someone in Japan is in love with Switzerland, its culture, its folklore and, more specifically: the Swiss alphorn! The Tamagawa Alphorn Club from Nanasawa, Japan, is travelling to Switzerland to attend the International Alphorn Festival in Nendaz at the end of July Alphorn playing started to be known in Japan in the 80ies and is becoming more and more popular in the last decade among retired people, but not only Shigetoshi Nakagawa, founder of the group and a forest expert, is one of the first people who started to play the instrument; he has instructed to build and play the Alphorn in numerous regions, among children and elderly people Thousands of Alphorn Clubs have been born lately and more and more Japanese are being interested in Swiss folklore culture and Switzerland in general

programme.title: The Natural History of the Chicken
programme.desc: A quirky documentary exploring chickens beyond food, through eccentric stories of headless runners, supernatural tales, and a woman who'd rather bond than eat them

programme.title: K2 and The Invisible Footmen
programme.desc: K2 is widely seen as the world's harshest mountain Yet many indigenous porters make a living in its extreme conditions, carrying provisions for foreign climbing expeditions Often risking their lives with only rudimentary equipment, they receive minimal pay for their efforts Against a backdrop of breathtaking natural beauty, this cinematic doc explores the everyday courage and sacrifice of the men who call the 'Savage Mountain' their home

programme.title: True or False
programme.desc: It is the most serious scandal ever hitting the modern art market An affair that has made experts and auction houses tremble and has re-proposed the ghost of forgery The facts date back to 2017 in Genoa, where an exhibition dedicated to the painter Amedeo Modigliani from Livorno was closed by the Public Prosecutor’s Office, which put 21 paintings out of the 60 on display under seizure

programme.title: A Russian Fairytale
programme.desc: Following the break up of the Soviet union, a gang of children from broken homes made a new life together inside the derelict buildings of a once secret weapons manufacturing city In their childhood innocence, they thought they were living a fairytale dream of freedom, but with starvation and sub zero temperatures crippling their health, reality soon hit home Despite their efforts to care for one another, three members of their group died For the survivors: they must try against hopeless odds to turn their lives around

programme.title: Black and Blue
programme.desc: In 2011, six police officers in Fullerton, California, beat Kelly Thomas, a homeless schizophrenic man, so badly that he died of his injuries Three years later, protests in Hollywood sparked after the officers were acquitted or had their charges dropped Renowned filmmaker Dylan Avery attended the protest and, before he knew it, he was swept up into a world of grieving family members, retired police officers that now criticize the very system they used to serve, and civilians who have suffered brutality at the hands of those sworn to protect Over the next two years, Avery followed multiple cases and developments that coincided with historic protests on the streets of Ferguson and Baltimore against institutionalized police racism and brutality

programme.title: The Rapture Of Free Soloing On Acid
programme.desc: This film follows the legendary climbing photographer and Stone Master, Dean Fidelman Fidelman was at the forefront of the free climbing revolution in Yosemite Valley and Joshua Tree during the 1970s, making photographs with John Bachar, Lynn Hill, Ron Kauk, John Long, and many other talented climbers Over the past four decades, Fidelman has continued to document the evolution of rock climbing as a sport and culture This documentary takes a look at his impact and influence as a photographer and climber

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國、英國、 瑞士、澳洲、土耳其、以色列、埃及、中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。n一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天5 我為上帝精彩過
programme.desc: 在人生旅途中走歪路、下錯車,弄得滿身傷痕、萬劫不復,惟有祂並不介意我們的過去,願意領我們走向美好的將來。《如果還有明天5我為上帝精彩過》,深入中國廣西山區孤兒院,記錄殘障青年在信仰中找回尊嚴和盼望的故事。攝製隊再遠赴南半球,見證澳洲天生失明女歌手及輪椅上的媽媽,突破身體局限活出主愛無限;還有美國摘冠

programme.title: 世界生命之道:鄺保亮牧師
programme.desc: 鄺保亮牧師,與父親鄺健雄牧師一同於新加坡帶領9千多人的教會,承傳父親熱心佈道的精神,繼續以激勵人心的資訊,挑戰我們成為為主擺上的門徒!

programme.title: 一生最美的祝福音樂巡迴佈道會
programme.desc: 由「愛基金」主辦、「創世電視」協辦的「一生最美的祝福音樂巡迴佈道會」,聯合不同教會的力量,加上演藝人的見證,將福音帶給香港市民。

programme.title: 屬靈教室: 啟示錄研讀-張永信牧師
programme.desc: 聖經最後的一卷啟示錄,常被信徒,甚至普世人類所注重。可惜的是,被誤解和誤用的情況卻很普遍。解釋啟示錄最大的問題,便是讀者們對於此書卷的體裁所知甚少,以致不明白詮釋啟示錄的方法。本節目傾重於對啟示錄體裁的闡釋,讓觀眾明白如何將方法論,應用在各有關的經文上。

programme.title: 屬靈教室:蔡錦圖博士-保羅腳蹤
programme.desc: 使徒保羅足跡遍及大馬士革、耶路撒冷、安提亞、路區得、庇哩亞、雅典、羅馬等,沙田浸信會傳道蔡錦圖博士,就會按地方有系統地講解保羅的生平,從中激勵我們學習初期使徒,為主擺上,跟隨耶穌的腳蹤行。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽
programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.desc: 節目記錄葛培理佈道團最新福音事工,並葛培理牧師70年來佈道的足跡及對世界各地的貢獻,讓我們面對不同的世情,仍然把握機會傳福音。

programme.title: 聖地流動教室-以色列破謎之旅

programme.title: 鋼琴大師的生命樂章
programme.desc: 巴哈, 莫劄特, 貝多芬, 蕭邦 - 四位誇越時代的鋼琴大師,在他們的生命樂章裏面,上帝的音符不斷跳動,並且影響後世無數音樂家。國際知名鋼琴家Sandra Wright Shen,曾獲得多個國際鋼琴大賽的冠軍,她將會為我們分享四位鋼琴大師的信仰故事。

programme.desc: 如何建立健康強盛的教會? 改變社區可以轉化城市? 作為基督徒,我們又如何盡忠地完成普世宣教使命? 一個「幸福小組」,讓教會續步履行三個使命!由台灣高雄福氣教會牧者主講,從《聖經》的話語開始,一起來學習「幸福」智慧!

programme.title: 「創世電視福音主日」-有一種體驗叫終生美麗
programme.desc: 「超闊銀幕震撼影像」遇上「意想不到又大眾化的福音主題」,加上「誠意的款待」會產生極致的「福音體驗」

programme.title: 屬靈教室: 啟示錄研讀-張永信牧師
programme.desc: 聖經最後的一卷啟示錄,常被信徒,甚至普世人類所注重。可惜的是,被誤解和誤用的情況卻很普遍。解釋啟示錄最大的問題,便是讀者們對於此書卷的體裁所知甚少,以致不明白詮釋啟示錄的方法。本節目傾重於對啟示錄體裁的闡釋,讓觀眾明白如何將方法論,應用在各有關的經文上。

programme.title: 屬靈教室:蔡錦圖博士-保羅腳蹤
programme.desc: 使徒保羅足跡遍及大馬士革、耶路撒冷、安提亞、路區得、庇哩亞、雅典、羅馬等,沙田浸信會傳道蔡錦圖博士,就會按地方有系統地講解保羅的生平,從中激勵我們學習初期使徒,為主擺上,跟隨耶穌的腳蹤行。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.desc: 麗認為小孩是「萬惡的根源」，揚言絕不會生兒子。晚上美娜突然帶一名印度籍的男孩來到高家，眾人認定這名男孩就是亨的兒子，身為女朋友的麗就負起照顧他的責任，這名男孩「大眼仔」不停跟著高麗，令她不勝其煩。

阿媽教落食平D粵
programme.desc: 肥媽要陸浩明自己動手煮出十餸五飯，看似沒可能？只要有電飯煲、煮食紙及肥媽準備好的食材，便變得異常簡單！六號自稱已變身「摺紙大師」，把「欖菜四季豆」、「蝦醬豬肉」、「麵醬豆角」、「梅菜菜心」摺好，蒸出來美味無窮。肥媽還自創菜式，將玉子豆腐釀入翠玉瓜，再灑上金華火腿碎作調味！肥媽購入雜菇雜菜做出一道滋味素飯，花盡心思卻換來六號的質疑！肥媽還教大家令蒸水蛋變滑、醃雞入味、梅菜出味的小小技巧。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 若戴隱形眼鏡時間過長，甚至戴着入睡，都可能引致角膜或眼球結構受損。眼科醫生建議不宜佩戴超過6至8小時，並細說正確清潔步驟。他亦提醒如角膜有微小擦傷，在郊外接觸水源時，會面臨感染阿米巴變形蟲風險。陳美齡再次作客受訪，談到育兒心得，她呼籲父母宜培養子女肯定自我，也要鼓勵孩子保持好奇心。她又剖白2007年確診乳癌後的抗病歷程與心路轉變，並勉勵大家珍惜當下。「睇餸食飯」環節，陳國賓示範「宮保蝦丁生菜包」。

programme.title: BB要健康粵
programme.desc: 新手父母張達倫、宋熙年到臨討論「湊B」疑難，還有兒科醫生、物理治療師及陪月顧問帶來專業意見。「媽媽級」主持陳敏之「公器私用」，趁機會向醫生請教如何幫孩子戒奶嘴，各位父母可有相同煩惱？眾人又談到「餵夜奶」問題，有專家竟笑稱父母要BB戒夜奶，其實出於懶惰？郭田葰外出找來吳恒亮博士明辨是非，解構不同款式揹帶的優劣；資深陪月員亦會分享選擇奶樽須知。此外，Bob於今集突然要和敏之「對襯家」，究竟發生甚麼事？

programme.title: 老表，你好hea！#23粵PG
programme.desc: 林雪大紅後，要求住在原處。林雪遭粉絲綁架，並要求見其男友，兩人遇上利亞，林雪與利亞在危急關頭露出真情。有雜誌抹黑在野鹹豬手，在野承認已與靜雯秘婚，拉美在記者會公開兩人夫妻關係，令秋水火冒三丈。

櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子對藝術品產生了興趣，於是求媽媽帶他前往東京的博物館。小丸子認為一天的運勢，是取決於早上有沒有好事發生。但經小玉提點之後，小丸子發覺一天運勢的好壞，也許是與笑容有關。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 「粵劇READY GO」環節，帶大家了解花木蘭女扮男裝、代父從軍的經典故事。曉瑩老師除了傳授「拉山」與「亮相」的粵劇基本功，更會仔細講解《木蘭辭》選段的造手與唱曲重點，隨後還會帶領小朋友進行演練。另外，「Artspiration」則以「森林」為創作主題。繪畫導師會示範如何畫出兇猛的豹子、爬樹的馬騮，以及擁有大嘴巴的鸚鵡，再巧妙融合草地與大樹背景，呈現生機盎然的森林景象。

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 多啦A夢用強力扇「風神」幫大雄消暑，大雄卻發明「拍拍拍飄飄飄」飛行運動，結果令到眾人失控。大雄因被父母責罵想離家出走，遇上同樣離家的未來兒子雄助，逐漸明白父母管教背後的擔憂與苦心。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#60粵
programme.desc: 嘉冰以為所住大廈鄰里和睦，唐芯卻指眾人各懷鬼胎。萬里身為當屆業主立案法團主席，一向以非常手段對付違規住戶，令街坊聞風喪膽。副主席楚瑠香一直伺機取代萬里，得知她出埠公幹、短期內不會回來，遂要求重選主席，更濫用代主席特權「為所欲為」，令嘉冰等苦不堪言，卻無力反抗。身為業主的龔喜決定參選法團主席，並以各種奇招拉票，支持率節節上升。豈料選舉當天，瑠香竟使陰招令龔喜被困，未能準時到場，恐被視作自動棄權……

programme.title: 澳門上葡京綜合度假村呈獻：璀璨之城#16粵PG 及 才駿HASHTAG 科技新指標粵
programme.desc: 孝賢為爭奪LKS董事席位，不惜脅逼海允繼續為他效力，海允縱想逃離，卻因一事而只能於孝賢指使下，暗中與雪瑩合作，試圖尋找孝賢的罪證……海允與雪瑩在合作中，冰釋前嫌。俊宇甦醒，得知喪兄消息，他其後決心公開一個真相；局勢逆轉，楚媚撤銷對孝賢的支持。孝賢為挽回局面而對楚媚設局，威脅他支持自己。俊宇之事，導致雪瑩與麗明爆發激烈衝突。麗明在官家大宅滾下樓梯，傷勢嚴重；孝君發現麗明出事真相，向雪瑩提出離婚……

programme.title: 與廚同行 家樂牌專業餐飲呈獻：美食強人粵
programme.desc: 黯然銷魂飯，真的只是叉燒飯加煎蛋這麼簡單？灣仔街市內的燒味店由藍帶廚師主理，就連配飯的豉油汁亦用上兩天製作，認真講究。第一刀脢頭叉燒油脂分佈平均、口感爽彈，被指為最滋味的部位，有名廚卻偏偏指定要吃「第二刀」，認為這才可試出真功夫？本港另一餐廳則以泰式方法炮製燶邊流心蛋，做法獲得不少評審歡心。至於其厚切叉燒，評審們則各有所好。此外，星級嘉賓薛家燕重演關於銷魂飯的電影經典一幕並起舞，收穫全場熱烈掌聲。

programme.title: 武則天#16粵普
programme.desc: 韋妃與李泰利用「女主武氏」流言對付媚娘，李淳風離奇身亡且手握其八字。群臣請誅媚娘，世民力拒，無忌卻主張寧殺勿縱。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
騙中傳奇#1粵
programme.desc: 文武廟內，眾神棍正利用種錢騙術欺騙無知婦孺，余忠正假扮富商，偕同黨顧井扮轎夫到場。神棍見忠正珠光寶氣，忙傾盡錢財欲騙取忠正手上之銀兩，卻反被忠正以其人之道還治其人之身，損失慘重。忠正與顧井雖是市井流氓，經常呃呃騙騙，但二人都非常孝順。忠正到妓院尋歡，與牙行少爺江玉麟生誤會，而顧井則對大鬧妓院的玉麟未婚妻錢寶兒迷倒。各牙行均隆重其事派出代表出席鑑別大會，忠正與顧井混入會場，卻被玉麟逮個正著。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 疑似慣犯於港鐵車廂做出猥褻舉動，該男子隨後更尾隨受其行為滋擾的女士下車，事主即時高呼非禮……每逢星期五，尖沙咀清真寺外都湧現「伸手黨」？有指他們濫用回教徒的捐獻美德，連番要索取金錢，甚至為爭位而發生肢體衝突。攝製隊深入調查，發現個別伸手黨並非貧困人士，更疑似有人利用捐款濫藥！《璀璨之城》步入結局篇，送上宣傳花絮。《夫妻肺片2》錄影，「胡說八道會」成員胡杏兒、胡定欣等擔任嘉賓。另帶來關於牛奶的資訊。

阿媽教落食平D粵
programme.desc: 誰說電飯煲一定要煮飯？肥媽相信，小小的電飯煲，也可完成燉湯、煲粥、煲糖水的任務！用電飯煲燉湯前，為何要先「煮毛巾」？肥媽買來三種番薯，準備煲「栗子地瓜滑雞丸粥」，順道提及想買較甜煨番薯的注意地方。上輯曾用慢煮棒慢煮豬扒，原來電飯煲亦可「慢煮乳鴿」，但一定要煮好汁料，不能偷懶！六號化身韓兵，聽從指令煮出潮流「韓式部隊鍋」，亦按指示逐一放入「芋頭椰香喳咋」的材料，同時發揮「靈活變通不浪費」的精神！

programme.title: 才駿HASHTAG 科技新指標粵
流行都市粵
programme.desc: 腦積水乍聽駭人，「水」其實從何而來？神經外科醫生指這狀況有機會源於腦腫瘤，可怎樣確診？醫生強調先找方法處理腦積水以降低腦壓，再施外科手術切除腫瘤，並考慮腦水的引流方法。「三太」樊亦敏以新角色「龔喜」加入《三代同糖》，繼《開心速遞》後再「回家」，發放歡樂！主持關注到三太身型上的改變外，也好奇她如何於日常生活保持正能量；曾因患病引致嚴重脫髮的她又是如何跨過逆境？「睇餸食飯」，三姐奉上「芋香腐乳燜雞」。

programme.title: BB要健康粵
programme.desc: 不少父母會為孩子報讀Playgroup、學前班等，究竟是否必要？今集請來朱凱婷、鄧梓峰、楊思琦參與討論。兼顧幼兒教育事業的梓峰不鼓勵父母陪同子女上課，凱婷竟有不同看法？言語治療師指出六歲前是學習語言的黃金期，家長可怎樣協助訓練？心理學家提到Messy Play能讓嬰幼兒透過感覺學習，節目介紹箇中特點。管教孩子常會出現無法預料的情況，爸媽的情緒管理備受考驗。梓峰便曾因生氣向女兒淋凍水，到底發生何事？

programme.title: 才駿HASHTAG 科技新指標粵

programme.desc: 利亞激發露宿者對音樂的鬥志，林雪內心暗喜。靜雯為了在野，決定離開家庭，秋水只有答應兩人婚事。結婚當日，齊家出盡方法為難在野。婚宴上，林雪送上驚喜。秋水擔心在野收入，尤長說會分錢，令尤田感不公平……

櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 藤木因為在公園不小心弄亂了別人以橡子砌的圖形，因此以葉片留下訊息道歉。第二天，藤木發現對方留言回應了。爺爺因為多次答錯電視問答節目的問題，而被小丸子認為爺爺的說話不可信。

programme.title: Hands Up粵

programme.title: 麵包超人粵日

programme.title: 與廚同行 家樂牌專業餐飲呈獻：美食強人粵

programme.title: 流行都市粵

programme.title: 美女廚房粵

programme.title: AI智有計粵

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 口乾、眼乾等都是乾燥症常見徵狀，大眾常誤將這病與季節乾燥拉上關係，風濕病科醫生糾正這其實是自身免疫疾病。患者可能出現吞嚥困難、常流眼水等，令日常生活受影響。醫生細說診治資訊，並為患者帶來日常護理建議。膀胱癌是常見泌尿系統癌症之一，吸煙、長期接觸化學物品等均會增加患病風險。臨床腫瘤科醫生詳析此症不同分期與治療方案，並提醒市民若出現血尿等警號要及早求醫。「睇餸食飯」，名廚鄭錦富示範「鹹菜豉椒炒肚尖」。

programme.title: Hands Up粵

programme.desc: 九龍灣一個入伙2年的半新盤，有高層兩房的貨尾交樓，需面對西斜問題，單位質素如何？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 有理說得清粵
AI智有計粵
programme.desc: 為推動本港人工智能生態圈的發展，政府撥款三十億元推行為期三年的人工智能資助計劃，以資助本地院校、研發機構、政府部門及企業等善用數碼港人工智能超算中心（超算中心）所提供的算力，推動科研突破；加強超算中心的網絡安全和數據保護；以及進行推廣和教育活動等，從而吸引海內外人工智能專家、企業及研發項目落戶香港。本系列將分五集，逐一探討計劃對醫療診斷、數碼安全、產業應用等，為市民生活帶來的實際幫助。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#62粵
programme.desc: 冠一與圓圓相戀，惟戀情不獲看好。冠一的前女友Erica與其死對頭Haydrian搭上，更獲邀參加電視真人騷《少爺們的戀愛》，冠一遂決定與圓圓參加節目。楊帆擔心冠一會惹來麻煩，圓圓卻自信能管束他。製作組安排三對情侶進行連串比賽，並刻意安排冠一與圓圓的前度在其中，藉以挑起紛爭。冠一與圓圓先敗一仗，製作組捕捉到冠一發少爺脾氣一幕，網民大肆抨擊。冠一又不滿要在鏡頭前幫圓圓拿行李，故意冷落她……

programme.title: 澳門上葡京綜合度假村呈獻：璀璨之城#18粵PG
programme.desc: 尚利鋒集團主席官志琛在澳門雄霸一方，這商界巨人安排兩子官孝賢、官孝君，出任集團聯席行政總裁，平起平坐。孝賢一直視孝君為眼中釘，為瓦解孝君和其夫人王雪瑩的強大團夥，孝賢宣佈與香港檢控官洪海允成婚。海允與雪瑩本是閨密，出身於十月初五街，但雪瑩為嫁入豪門，奪去海允的情人孝君。孝賢就是要利用海允心中的仇恨，化成攻擊孝君夫婦的利器。在家族各人看似充滿機心的環境中，孝君卻堅守正義，奮力抵抗着孝賢的步步進逼……

programme.title: 與廚同行 家樂牌專業餐飲呈獻：美食強人粵
programme.desc: 雞湯拉麵在港捲起熱潮，日籍料理達人直言香港水準不遜日本！隱藏於西環後巷的小店，結合日式食材與西式技法，煮出濃而不膩的雞白湯，配上爽口麵條、棉花糖口感的慢煮雞胸，堪稱黃金組合；探店專員浚霆還帶來隱藏食法。評審團讚不絕口，出品能否衝擊最高評級？位於屯門的長龍店自設製麵工場，研製滑得來煙韌的多加水麵，神秘美食家點出店方所用水不簡單！本地鮮雞燉煮靚湯，再以海味與五種醬油提升湯底層次，有名廚卻指味道混濁？

programme.title: 武則天#18粵普
programme.desc: 世民為保媚娘刻意冷落她，轉而召徐慧並寵幸蕭薔。媚娘獨自放天燈、屢候世民不至，仍不知疏遠其實是保護。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
騙中傳奇#3粵PG
programme.desc: 玉麟與僕人九斤二喬裝羊牯，引忠正上吊，忠正與顧井原形畢露，更被押入監牢。忠正父余實前往探監，向忠正說出當年與玉麟父江守言之恩怨。當年余實替人打造棉被，被冤枉偷工減料，找來有「天下第一牙」之稱的守言作公證，惜守言判斷錯誤，令余實蒙上不白之冤，余實更因此顛沛流離。余實大鬧守言家，守言詐暈逃避，後向玉麟道出當年事，遂勸玉麟放掉忠正，以作補償。忠正與顧井獲釋後，與家人一起晚飯，豈料公差又至，再次拘捕二人。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 口乾、眼乾等都是乾燥症常見徵狀，大眾常誤將這病與季節乾燥拉上關係，風濕病科醫生糾正這其實是自身免疫疾病。患者可能出現吞嚥困難、常流眼水等，令日常生活受影響。醫生細說診治資訊，並為患者帶來日常護理建議。膀胱癌是常見泌尿系統癌症之一，吸煙、長期接觸化學物品等均會增加患病風險。臨床腫瘤科醫生詳析此症不同分期與治療方案，並提醒市民若出現血尿等警號要及早求醫。「睇餸食飯」，名廚鄭錦富示範「鹹菜豉椒炒肚尖」。

programme.title: BB要健康粵
programme.desc: 家長可會考慮給孩子進食營養補充劑？「星級」媽媽湯盈盈稱寧願以補充劑代替糖果，兒科醫生卻提醒要注意進食份量，更指曾有個案因服食過量維他命A引致肝功能受損！營養師則帶來保持小朋友腸道健康的要訣，是否建議服用益生菌？今回又請來BB按摩師、物理治療師，分別示範嬰兒按摩和BB運動；另有郭田葰外出了解BB Spa資訊。中醫、按摩被列入自然療法，「星級」爸爸周志康與新手媽媽梁麗翹亦試過為BB按摩，達致通便效果。

programme.title: 老表，你好hea！#25粵PG
programme.desc: 林雪帶利亞及露宿者到高音錄音室，還取名為半紅不黑。尤田急於物色為他生育的女人，看中了金礦，落力配合她的要求。靜雯被逼出戰立法會選舉，與在野打對台。高音追究半紅不黑擅用錄音室，令利亞欲與林雪割斷關係……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#220粵
programme.desc: 藥房稀客來向喜道謝，原來喜兩年前令他不肖子成家立室。喜羨慕非常，更召開家庭會議，稱由她支付買樓的首期，迫義與花買樓置業。喜此舉卻打亂了義與花的計劃，二人決定使出「拖字訣」，但喜卻使計強拉二人去睇樓。

programme.title: 玉樓春#34粵普PG
programme.desc: 孫俊豪認定谷野是奸細，在民眾壓力下，要把谷野斬首，姚滴珠闖刑場拼命為他求情。孫有德的丈夫去世，林少春陪孫母去李家奔喪。李家二兒子李想和夫人一心想把家中財政大權搶過來，孫母很看不慣李家眾人的行事作風。

programme.title: Sunday好戲王粵PG
programme.desc: 姜大衛登上「星級」評判寶座，審視劇集《EU超時任務》演員王浩信、朱千雪、單立文、譚凱琪的演技比拼，還有袁偉豪現身支持同劇好友。眾人能否「超額」完成搞笑任務？「睇你點死」環節，豹哥、千雪、浩信、凱琪、偉豪各要做出「浸豬籠」、烙刑、剝皮、杖刑、問吊等受刑致死的狀況，繼而延伸其他離奇死相。John哥看得「戲癮」大發，應邀上台扮演跟敵人「同歸於盡」的刀客，親身示範好戲！節目還會表揚「打手王」資深綠葉演員。

programme.title: 熱血軍檢
programme.desc: 【安普賢攜手曹寶兒，成最強軍檢察官搭檔！！】以韓國軍事法庭為背景，為了各自目的而成為軍檢察官，都培萬只想往上爬達成復仇目標，車友仁出身軍法世家，為替父母討回公道而回到軍中。當軍中黑暗勢力浮上檯面，他們選擇不再服從命令，而是直面權力、揭露真相。在正義與復仇之間，兩人逐步找回真正的信念，也點燃危險又炙熱的同盟關係，從對立到並肩作戰的故事。

programme.title: 絕妙的遺產
programme.desc: 【拒分遺產！為教訓貪財不孝子老父親再婚年輕單親媽】80歲的老闆夫英培，經營50年歷史的平壤冷麵老店，在一次睡夢中偶然靈魂出竅，4名兒子誤以為父親死亡，正在房外討論著如何分配爸爸的遺產。看著這些不成材的兒子們只想著財產，令夫英培非常痛心，醒來後打算將財產全數捐出，不料遭到基金會拒收。在一次偶然事件中，與30歲的單親媽媽孔桂玉相遇，並打算在兒子面前上演假結婚，當桂玉正式成為繼母後，兒子們慌了手腳，經過朝夕相處後，一家人克服了偏見，兒子們也不再覬覦遺產，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 裸婚時代
programme.desc: 【八年愛情遇上現實婚後生活秒變修羅場】劉易陽與童佳倩相戀八年，決定在懷孕之際不顧家境懸殊與雙方父母的強烈反對，選擇沒房、沒車、沒鑽戒、沒婚禮的「裸婚」。兩人原以為愛情足以抵擋現實，但婚後卻發現，與易陽父母同住的壓力、兩家價值觀的衝突，以及柴米油鹽的重擔正逐步侵蝕他們的浪漫。當理想被生活逼到牆角，這對一路走來的戀人，究竟能否守住最初的承諾，為愛打下一個真正的家？

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 【婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟】一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆、媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下。撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異、傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱。她們相互扶持、攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 模範刑警
programme.desc: 【孫賢周攜手張勝祖，最強刑警搭檔追查冤案揭開真相！！】資深刑警姜道昌憑經驗與直覺，與只相信證據的天才刑警吳志赫成了新搭檔。兩人辦案風格迥異，從衝突到合作，逐漸建立默契。面對五年前女高中生遇害的案件出現新的疑點，兩人聯手出擊揭開掩蓋的真相，對抗試圖隱瞞冤案的權力與勢力找出真兇。

programme.title: 風起西州
programme.desc: 【《風起霓裳》最新續作！！許魏洲、古力娜扎續夫妻情緣，琴瑟和鳴的婚後生活及事業新考驗！！】製衣才女庫狄琉璃與裴行儉婚後面對大長公主的屢次使計刁難，琉璃聰慧應對，化險為夷。裴行儉因意外被貶遠赴西州上任，夫妻攜手同心，琉璃發揮自己的長才，傳授西州百姓製衣技巧。裴行儉則守護西州百姓經濟富足、安居樂業。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 時光之城
programme.desc: 【橫跨兩國人氣演員的偶像劇，張哲瀚攜手朴敏英初嘗試愛情羅曼史！！】樂觀積極的元氣少女許真，在前往蓋亞影視應徵時撞見了當紅炸子雞顧持鈞被前女友拒絕的場面。不希望丟臉的事情曝光的顧持鈞則從中作梗想趕走許真，卻陰錯陽差的在蓋亞集團二公子林晉修的幫助下，反而成為了顧持鈞的助理。朝夕相處、情愫蔓延，卻同時捲入了集團的陰謀，兩人要如何逃出危機，讓有情人終成眷屬呢?

programme.title: 絕妙的遺產
programme.desc: 【拒分遺產！為教訓貪財不孝子老父親再婚年輕單親媽】80歲的老闆夫英培，經營50年歷史的平壤冷麵老店，在一次睡夢中偶然靈魂出竅，4名兒子誤以為父親死亡，正在房外討論著如何分配爸爸的遺產。看著這些不成材的兒子們只想著財產，令夫英培非常痛心，醒來後打算將財產全數捐出，不料遭到基金會拒收。在一次偶然事件中，與30歲的單親媽媽孔桂玉相遇，並打算在兒子面前上演假結婚，當桂玉正式成為繼母後，兒子們慌了手腳，經過朝夕相處後，一家人克服了偏見，兒子們也不再覬覦遺產，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 熱血軍檢
programme.desc: 【安普賢攜手曹寶兒，成最強軍檢察官搭檔！！】以韓國軍事法庭為背景，為了各自目的而成為軍檢察官，都培萬只想往上爬達成復仇目標，車友仁出身軍法世家，為替父母討回公道而回到軍中。當軍中黑暗勢力浮上檯面，他們選擇不再服從命令，而是直面權力、揭露真相。在正義與復仇之間，兩人逐步找回真正的信念，也點燃危險又炙熱的同盟關係，從對立到並肩作戰的故事。

programme.title: 裸婚時代
programme.desc: 【八年愛情遇上現實婚後生活秒變修羅場】劉易陽與童佳倩相戀八年，決定在懷孕之際不顧家境懸殊與雙方父母的強烈反對，選擇沒房、沒車、沒鑽戒、沒婚禮的「裸婚」。兩人原以為愛情足以抵擋現實，但婚後卻發現，與易陽父母同住的壓力、兩家價值觀的衝突，以及柴米油鹽的重擔正逐步侵蝕他們的浪漫。當理想被生活逼到牆角，這對一路走來的戀人，究竟能否守住最初的承諾，為愛打下一個真正的家？

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 【婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟】一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆、媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下。撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異、傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱。她們相互扶持、攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 模範刑警
programme.desc: 【孫賢周攜手張勝祖，最強刑警搭檔追查冤案揭開真相！！】資深刑警姜道昌憑經驗與直覺，與只相信證據的天才刑警吳志赫成了新搭檔。兩人辦案風格迥異，從衝突到合作，逐漸建立默契。面對五年前女高中生遇害的案件出現新的疑點，兩人聯手出擊揭開掩蓋的真相，對抗試圖隱瞞冤案的權力與勢力找出真兇。

programme.title: 風起西州
programme.desc: 【《風起霓裳》最新續作！！許魏洲、古力娜扎續夫妻情緣，琴瑟和鳴的婚後生活及事業新考驗！！】製衣才女庫狄琉璃與裴行儉婚後面對大長公主的屢次使計刁難，琉璃聰慧應對，化險為夷。裴行儉因意外被貶遠赴西州上任，夫妻攜手同心，琉璃發揮自己的長才，傳授西州百姓製衣技巧。裴行儉則守護西州百姓經濟富足、安居樂業。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 時光之城
programme.desc: 【橫跨兩國人氣演員的偶像劇，張哲瀚攜手朴敏英初嘗試愛情羅曼史！！】樂觀積極的元氣少女許真，在前往蓋亞影視應徵時撞見了當紅炸子雞顧持鈞被前女友拒絕的場面。不希望丟臉的事情曝光的顧持鈞則從中作梗想趕走許真，卻陰錯陽差的在蓋亞集團二公子林晉修的幫助下，反而成為了顧持鈞的助理。朝夕相處、情愫蔓延，卻同時捲入了集團的陰謀，兩人要如何逃出危機，讓有情人終成眷屬呢?

programme.title: 模範刑警
programme.desc: 【孫賢周攜手張勝祖，最強刑警搭檔追查冤案揭開真相！！】資深刑警姜道昌憑經驗與直覺，與只相信證據的天才刑警吳志赫成了新搭檔。兩人辦案風格迥異，從衝突到合作，逐漸建立默契。面對五年前女高中生遇害的案件出現新的疑點，兩人聯手出擊揭開掩蓋的真相，對抗試圖隱瞞冤案的權力與勢力找出真兇。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 風起西州
programme.desc: 【《風起霓裳》最新續作！！許魏洲、古力娜扎續夫妻情緣，琴瑟和鳴的婚後生活及事業新考驗！！】製衣才女庫狄琉璃與裴行儉婚後面對大長公主的屢次使計刁難，琉璃聰慧應對，化險為夷。裴行儉因意外被貶遠赴西州上任，夫妻攜手同心，琉璃發揮自己的長才，傳授西州百姓製衣技巧。裴行儉則守護西州百姓經濟富足、安居樂業。

programme.title: 時光之城
programme.desc: 【橫跨兩國人氣演員的偶像劇，張哲瀚攜手朴敏英初嘗試愛情羅曼史！！】樂觀積極的元氣少女許真，在前往蓋亞影視應徵時撞見了當紅炸子雞顧持鈞被前女友拒絕的場面。不希望丟臉的事情曝光的顧持鈞則從中作梗想趕走許真，卻陰錯陽差的在蓋亞集團二公子林晉修的幫助下，反而成為了顧持鈞的助理。朝夕相處、情愫蔓延，卻同時捲入了集團的陰謀，兩人要如何逃出危機，讓有情人終成眷屬呢?

programme.title: Timmy Time
programme.desc: Being an ‘only lamb in the flock’ Timmy has been used to getting his own way. Now for the first time Timmy is going to have to learn to get along with other little animals. Timmy is going to Nursery! Self-willed and naughty Timmy is going to have to learn how to share things with other youngsters and think about their feelings – not just his. Timmy is a gifted little footballer who needs to learn that it’s not enough to kick the ball – you have to pass it too. Harriet Heron and Osbourne Owl, who run the Nursery are going to have their hands full, but Timmy gets it right in the end with a little help from his friends of the furry, feathery and spikey type.

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Recycling Truck
programme.desc: Maisy and Tallulah drive their recycling truck around the community.

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Cheeky Chicks
programme.desc: Maisy finds cheeky chicks hiding around the farm and brings them back to the hen house.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Tomato
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits Theatre, Tomato changes colour.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Raspberry
programme.desc: Raspberry sings a song, saying it's cool to be kind.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - The Good, the Bad and the Prickly
programme.desc: Prickly Pear arrives in the supermarket and wants Evil Pea's freezer for his new home.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - The Great Book Rescue
programme.desc: Evil Pea takes all the books in the supermarket to build a huge tower.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Together
programme.desc: Dipsy and Laa‐Laa drive to the Hidey Hup in the Tubby Car. They meet Tinky Winky and Po and the Teletubbies go on the Tubby Uppy Downy together.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S03 - Milk
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'milk' and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. There's white milk, pink milk, baby milk and banana milk. We snuggle up for bedtime milk and even enjoy some mighty milk and monster milk! The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way and everyone has a boogie when Dee's friend finally succeeds in saying today's word!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S03 - Sleepless in OKIDO
programme.desc: It's the Great OKIDO Sleepover, but there is a loud noise keeping Messy awake! With the help of Zoom, Messy must track down the noise to save the sleepover.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Cliffhanger
programme.desc: Felix the pig is stuck on a cliff ledge where not even Mojo's tops can reach him. They will need to be creative to get Bo up there and save that poor pig!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Slide
programme.desc: Bingo and Lila are excited to play on their new waterslide.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - TV Shop
programme.desc: At the chemist, Bluey and Bingo have fun playing with the CCTV screens.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Shopping Badge
programme.desc: Duggee loves to shop local, so the Big Shop is a Big Deal for him. He's over-excited and wants two of everything. The Squirrels have to remind him 'we only popped in for milk!'

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Good Choices
programme.desc: The Squirrels haven't been making good choices round the messy clubhouse. With Duggee's help, they start to get it right. But not before sending Roly's imagination into overdrive!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Animals
programme.desc: The Squirrel club play games involving animals. The chickens do some rhythmic office work.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Copy The King
programme.desc: The Squirrels play Copy the King!

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Mountain Gorillas, The Democratic Republic of the Congo
programme.desc: When a cold-ridden Glitch's sneezing breaks his TV, the Grimbots take him to the Virunga National Park in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to see a real mountain gorilla. But Glitch doesn't realise how dangerous his cold germs can be, so the Go Jetters will have to stop him from making a baby gorilla sick - all while trying to keep it safe from dangerous traps left by hunters.

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Bumpy And The Wise Old Wolfhound
programme.desc: Bingo is sick in hospital, so Bluey and Dad sent her a homemade video to lift her spirits. It tells the tale of Barnicus' quest to heal her spotty dog named Bumpy.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Typewriter
programme.desc: Bluey, Snickers, and Winton are on their way to ask Calypso for help with their problems, when they are ambushed by the Terriers and use their unique talents to get past.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Magic
programme.desc: Bluey teaches Bingo how to use magic so she can make Mum play with her, but she forgets to explain the most important rule: never use magic for cheekiness.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Chest
programme.desc: Dad tries to teach Bluey how to play chess, but Mum thinks she is still too young. When Bingo joins in, the kids make up their own rules, but they still can't beat Dad.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island S01 - Andy, the T Rex and the Volcano
programme.desc: When the ground begins to shake on Dino Island, Jen and Andy suspect the volcano is to blame. Along the way, Andy meets not one, but two T-rex's.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Paper Fan
programme.desc: It's a hot day in Playtime Towers, so Bella helps Lift cool down with a paper fan. Together, they visit Hettie in the Ice Disco, who has a flapping paper fan dance!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The River Badge
programme.desc: Duggee has a package that needs delivering right at the other end of the river, and a long way from the clubhouse. It looks like the squirrels are going to have a day out on the boat. Good job Duggee has his River badge!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Making Friends Badge
programme.desc: The squirrels are off for a Jamboree to make some new friends, play games and have a picnic. They meet another group of young animals with their very own version of Duggee but everything they do is different.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Camping Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the squirrels are going camping. They need to find somewhere to pitch their tent but it's not as easy as they thought it would be. They all work together and finally get settled. Then things start to unravel when the squirrels hear a scary noise outside the tent. What can it be? All sorts of things are imagined. DUGGEE!!

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Tepui Mountains, Venezuela
programme.desc: Foz, Kyan and Lars are climbing a Tepui in Venezuela, with Xuli exploring this amazing place in her Vroomster. Meanwhile, Grandmaster Glitch is lost and looking for his Grimbots in the thick clouds around the Tepui. He flies up and collides with the Vroomster, causing Xuli and him to crash into a sinkhole. With the Vroomster and their radios broken, it's up to them to find a way out together. However, their reluctance to form a team causes even more problems when a disagreement results in them l

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Tower Bridge, London
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch is visiting London and spots the perfect souvenir hat. But he's run out of pocket money, so he decides to earn some as a tour guide. The Go Jetters are also in London while Lars helps fix Tower Bridge. Xuli, Kyan and Foz decide to take a river tour, but they accidently get on Glitch's boat. programme.desc: Max and Monty's antics on a construction site get them into trouble when they ignore the danger warning signs.

programme.desc: Billy and the Sillies introduce a visit to chicken A&amp;E, the Squirrels build a bug house, Norrie has her chance to shine, and the Penguins give facts about what's hot and what's not.

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Great Big Painting
programme.desc: One rainy day, Maisy and her friends make a giant painting!

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Recycling Truck
programme.desc: Maisy and Tallulah drive their recycling truck around the community.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Brussels Sprout
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's tiny Brussels Sprout performing I'm Mighty and proving how great he is.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Tomato
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits Theatre, Tomato changes colour.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - The Great Book Rescue
programme.desc: Evil Pea takes all the books in the supermarket to build a huge tower.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Hiccup Havoc
programme.desc: Supertato uses his hiccups to save Tato Tower from Evil Pea's jam attack.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Together
programme.desc: Dipsy and Laa‐Laa drive to the Hidey Hup in the Tubby Car. They meet Tinky Winky and Po and the Teletubbies go on the Tubby Uppy Downy together.

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. David's sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona lies to David about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng...

programme.title: The Reckless Cricket
programme.desc: Inspired by “Drunken Master”, this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist creating a cricket-style fighting arts to fight and defeat the different martial artists who have beaten him before.

programme.title: Diary of a Lady-killer
programme.desc: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murdered one by one. Zhou becomes the number one suspect by the police but is the killer someone else?

programme.title: All Men are Brothers
programme.desc: This is a sequel to Chang Cheh's epic “The Water Margin”, and follows the patriotic story of seven warriors in the band of 108 outlaws at Mount Liang. The magnificent seven battle against the despotic government officials to save their country.

programme.title: Five Shaolin Masters
programme.desc: The Qing court plots to kill all Shaolin disciples by burning down Shaolin Temple. This sudden fire killed almost everyone except for five disciples. To take revenge on the Qing court, the five of them train hard in different fighting styles to become “The Five Shaolin Masters”.

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: The Snake Prince lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with other snakes and they have lived peacefully with humans for a thousand years. All things change however, when the Snake Prince falls in love with one of the three beauties performing a sensual rain dance in the nearby village one day, and decides to marry her at all costs...

programme.title: The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. This evil union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld King's sister and the Winged Tiger. Can this dangerous duo be stopped before one says "I do"?

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxu's enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.title: Vengeance is a Golden Blade
programme.desc: Convoy Master Li's wife has an affair with his rival Long, who plans to steal Li's Golden Blade and kill him as well as his young daughter. Li and his daughter manage to escape and the latter grows up to be a skilled swordswoman who vows to avenge her mother's death – a lie told by Li. The truth is revealed when she sees her mother alive by chance.

programme.title: Song Of Orchid Island
programme.desc: Dr. He moves to the remote Lanyu island off the coast of Taiwan to look for his long lost father, and starts to run a clinic curing islanders who are bitten by the fatal red worms there. He meets Ya Lan who works as a nurse in his clinic and falls in love with him. Things get vicious for Dr. He as a jealous islander plots to get rid of him...

programme.title: Kid From Kwangtung
programme.desc: Qing enforcer Luo Yi Hu murders rebel Chen Gui, forcing his wife and daughter Xiao Wei to flee to Guang Long Town. There, mischievous Jia Yu discovers his master's identity as a rebel while helping Xiao Wei. After his loved ones and mentor are killed, Jia Yu sheds his playful ways and seeks vengeance, facing the Qing forces in a final battle.

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: Rape of the Sword
programme.desc: The film starts out with two students fighting for their deceased master's sword called the "Green Frost Sword". Han kills the other student, takes the sword and offer it to the king. The wife of the other dead student plots to take revenge, going undercover to retrieve the sword at the first opportunity in this tale of revenge and betrayal.

programme.title: Swordsman at Large
programme.desc: Hsiao Shi Yi Lang is the Swordsman at large who everyone wants to kill. A magnificient sword is even created for this purpose though the blade is soon coveted more than the swordsman's death by it! Bandits, beauties and blade masters battle for survival in this exciting story of deceit, betrayal, and death.

programme.title: The Secret Of The Dirk
programme.desc: The inhabitants of the City of Liu are forced to flee when the vicious Black Tigers gang raids their city, but are able to hide all their gold and treasures in a valley. A team of swordswomen led by Liu wants to get their hands on the treasures before the bandits, but both parties will have to contend with the wandering swordsman Chou for them...

programme.title: The Secret Of The Dirk
programme.desc: The inhabitants of the City of Liu are forced to flee when the vicious Black Tigers gang raids their city, but are able to hide all their gold and treasures in a valley. A team of swordswomen led by Liu wants to get their hands on the treasures before the bandits, but both parties will have to contend with the wandering swordsman Chou for them...

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po plays a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter. After marrying, he soon discovers the reason for her hesitation. She is stricken with a contagious disease. But, with the power of true love, their romance prevails.

programme.title: Danger has Two Faces
programme.desc: Many years ago, Inspector Kam killed an innocent man and decided to resign from the police force. He became a professional killer who disguises as a pet store owner. When his best friend, Bobby begins investigating recent murder cases committed by Kam, he discovers that the mastermind behind these cases is actually his superintendent.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: The Supreme Swordsman
programme.desc: After beating several famous swordsmen, Chin Wu Hsin of the Mo Shan clan challenges Supreme Swordsman to a duel, hoping to win his title, and is beaten and humiliated. The winner taunts him to find a Supreme Sword made by Old Eagle, a famous sword-maker. When his offer to buy a sword from Old Eagle, is turned down, he challenges Old Eagle to a duel, and snatches his sword in a foul play. Old Eagle's own son Shih Yen-peh vows to avenge for his father...

programme.title: The Magnificent Ruffians
programme.desc: Renowned martial arts clan heir Yuan Ying Fei hires four down-and-out martial artists to eliminate the local escort agency's young chief, Guan Yuan. Unexpectedly, the four befriend Guan instead. When Yuan's conspiracy leads to Guan's death, they unite to avenge him.

programme.title: Dawn will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parent's consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her...

programme.title: The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: Carefree drifters Meng Gang and Tie Hu discover their purpose after meeting the revolutionary leader, Wan Tai. With the help of Meng Gang's girlfriend, they infiltrate a warlord camp to seize weapons for the revolutionary cause. Following a fierce battle, all three make the ultimate sacrifice, becoming the "Anonymous Heroes" of the revolution.

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: Kuo, a police's son, blames his father for his mother's death. He has no job, spends time in night clubs and always gets into fights. One night, Kuo rescues Mei from being raped and they become friends. Kuo wants to support Mei and her family so he goes gambling hoping to gain more money but bad luck seems to be following them with tragic outcomes.

programme.title: The Cave of Silken Web
programme.desc: In this third instalment of Shaw Brother's Journey to the West, Monk Tang San Zang is trapped by seven seductive spider spirits who are hell-bent on achieving immortality by eating him! Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing have to fight the spider spirits to rescue Monk Tang San Zang.

programme.title: The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: Set in the Tang Dynasty, the 13 adopted sons of Sha Tuo King are all renowned as royal warriors. David Chiang plays the 13th Prince, a powerful fighter whose prestigious status provokes jealously, leading to a gruesome family feud.

programme.title: The Silent Swordsman
programme.desc: Young swordsman Shen Bing Yi is appointed leader of the "Sun and Moon" secret society, sworn to take down a traitorous general conspiring with foreign invaders. While fighting for his nation, he captures the hearts of a spirited female warrior and two beautiful Uyghur princesses, leaving him caught between his duty and their devotion.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor scholar Lin is engaged to a wealthy family's daughter, but her father looks down on him due to his family's background. Before leaving for the Imperial Examination, Lin visits his fiancee, only to discover a maid dead in blood. When his bloody handprint is found at the scene, he becomes the prime suspect. Can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: The Tea House
programme.desc: Big Brother Cheng fled from the mainland to Hong Kong, where he opened a teahouse in a housing estate, hoping to find a peaceful life. However, relentless provocations from local triad gangs go unaddressed by the police, prompting Cheng and his friends at the teahouse to seek revenge.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: Village of Tigers
programme.desc: The devilish residents of the Village of Tigers, led by Hu Jiao, plan to kill Lo Hong Shun, otherwise known as the heroic Sword of the Southern Sky. Hu Jiao sees a way to use the righteousness of the honorable Ba family to help him kill the hero Lo by turning them against him. Will good prevail over evil?

programme.title: Call of the Sea
programme.desc: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yu's beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her. Chin Hu protects another woman from the bully one day, leading Hsiao Yu to misunderstand him and suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial arts world, and launches a scheme to pit the various heroes against one another.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a General's daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates. When she has to choose one of them to marry, how will Fei E tell them that she is a girl? To complicate matters, a girl who Fei E saves one day only wants to be married to her!

programme.title: Shaolin Hand Lock
programme.desc: Li Cheng Ying's father was set up and killed by his old friend Ling Hao. Li, who has learnt “Shaolin Hand Lock” from his father, is on a mission to avenge his death. He works as an undercover guard at Ling's house where he meets his long-lost brother, and the two team up to take revenge for their father against Ling.

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows...

programme.title: The Knight of Knights
programme.desc: Wen Su Chen, the leader of seven knights, sends his six sworn brothers to investigate a monastery. Unfortunately, they are killed by an abbot who plans to murder Inspector Lin. Wen saved Lin and battles the abbot to avenge his dead sworn brothers. With Lin and his army's help, they bring down the ruthless monks in the monastery.

programme.title: Hex after Hex
programme.desc: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular "Venom" Lo Meng.

programme.title: Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: The Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung is a group of anti-Ching martial artists who have killed a Ching official. Years later, when five disciples and descendants of Ten Tigers meet one night, one of them is killed by the son of the late Ching official who returns with a vengeance. They must fight against him to protect the Ten Tigers clan...

programme.title: Na Cha And The Seven Devils
programme.desc: While stealing one magical peach from a mystic tree in Heaven, Little Na Cha accidentally drops seven others on Earth, which transformed seven different animals into seven devils. Na Cha must hunt the devils down in ten days or his father will be punished by the King of Heaven. Can Na Cha complete his mission?

programme.title: Marco Polo
programme.desc: Mongolian emperor Kublai Khan is being assassinated while meeting with the Italian explorer Marco Polo. Marco Polo is appointed to lead the troops for the emperor to wipe out the anti-Mongol rebels. Yet, he is touched by these rebels who are resisting the Mongolian invasion of their homeland. Will Marco Polo stay loyal to the emperor?

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: Seventh Sister, a curious fairy from heaven, descends to 1970s Hong Kong. Lost in an unfamiliar world, she is rescued by Tung Chi Lap, who runs a debt-ridden orphanage. When a tycoon plots to seize the land, she uses her powers to protect it, and an unlikely romance begins.

programme.title: The Silver Fox
programme.desc: Hsia Wu and Sima Chau are adopted sons of an escort master. Greed drives Sima Chau to murder his master and disfigure Hsia Wu. Wounded, Hsia Wu flees with his young daughter, while his pregnant wife is raped and left unconscious. He raises his daughter in hatred, training her into the fearsome "Silver Fox" and sending her out for revenge.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the "corpse whisperer," forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao’s enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei’s concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then…

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Wusong VS Ximenqing
programme.desc: After uncovering his sister-in-law Pan Jin Lian’s affair with the corrupt Xi Men Qing, Wu Song is falsely accused and exiled. However, when his elder brother is murdered, Wu Song returns determined to seek justice. With the authorities refusing to punish the guilty, his fury drives him toward a bloody path of revenge.

programme.title: 36 Secrets of Courtship
programme.desc: This erotic comedy features three lotharios who vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School -- an extremely sexy institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student’s family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A master gambler and his partner are recruited to investigate a Shanghai tycoon suspected of using his casino as a front for espionage. As they enter the high-stakes gambling world, they must outwit a dangerous opponent in a deadly game of skill and deception.

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: Lonely cop Wong Wai Yip unknowingly saves the life of ruthless crime leader Hon Kong after a violent shootout. Soon after, a string of brutal murders shocks the city, forcing Wong to confront the truth behind the crimes. Consumed by guilt and haunted by his inner demons, he is pushed toward madness and must battle evil with evil.

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: Lonely cop Wong Wai Yip unknowingly saves the life of ruthless crime leader Hon Kong after a violent shootout. Soon after, a string of brutal murders shocks the city, forcing Wong to confront the truth behind the crimes. Consumed by guilt and haunted by his inner demons, he is pushed toward madness and must battle evil with evil.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm’s VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: Sent to Japan by his master, Chen Zhen rescues and falls in love with fellow student Hiroko Yamada, only to be drawn into the Black Dragon gang's conspiracy. As Chinese students disappear and Jing Wu Martial Arts School comes under attack, he joins Liang Shao Wen to destroy a secret lab, foil the conspiracy, and defend his nation's honour.

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li’s daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley’s mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The legendary Stone Monkey gives hope to a desperate girl by promising to change her fate. Years later, after a fierce battle against the powerful three-eyed God of War, he is defeated and cast into the mortal world. Stripped of his former glory, Stone Monkey must rise again, confront powerful enemies, and fulfil the promise he once made.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation…

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Vampire Vs Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Yat Mei and his disciples live in a remote village until Sister Maria restores an abandoned church, awakening a long-dormant vampire missionary. As panic spreads and Taoist exorcism fails, Yat Mei joins forces with a Western priest, combining Eastern and Western powers to battle evil.

programme.title: Vampire Vs Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Yat Mei and his disciples live in a remote village until Sister Maria restores an abandoned church, awakening a long-dormant vampire missionary. As panic spreads and Taoist exorcism fails, Yat Mei joins forces with a Western priest, combining Eastern and Western powers to battle evil.

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle…

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: A reactivated backup Chinese agent, posing as a butcher, is unexpectedly assigned to recover a stolen dinosaur skull. Sent to Hong Kong, he is aided by a female agent who is secretly working for the villains. Together, they navigate betrayals and confront the mastermind, ultimately recovering the national treasure and exposing the conspiracy.

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: The Viral Factor
programme.desc: IDC agent Jon survives a mission where his entire team is betrayed by their superior, Sean, leaving him with a life-threatening injury. Travelling to Malaysia to find his long-lost brother, he is drawn into a kidnapping case, only to discover his brother is involved, and Sean is the mastermind behind it all.

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called “Kung Fu Stuntmen”. This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognise.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie becomes a night guard at an abandoned building. Hours after their shift change, the previous guard is found murdered in a locked room, making Wang the prime suspect. As eerie events unfold, three vengeful ghosts appear and reveal a revenge plot. With misfortune piling up, is it fate or a curse?

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur…

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian arms dealer to locate and destroy a cache of munitions. However, when he finally finds them, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and must team up with his partner to recover the weapons and prevent a disaster.

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a “super pill” invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B’s superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.
